summary.en: An if-else runs exactly one branch.
summary.bn: দুটি বিকল্প পথ বেছে নাও এবং dangling else-এর ভুল braces দিয়ে এড়াও।

notes: if-else and nearest-unmatched-if pairing apply throughout the C editions used here. C17 introduces no special indentation rule. Braces remain the portable way to show explicit branch grouping.

examples.title: A pass or retry report
examples.explanationHtml: The inclusive comparison accepts forty, so Pass appears and Retry does not. Done follows either branch. A value of thirty-nine would switch only the selected first message; the common final line would remain.

examples.title: Parity for a negative input
examples.explanationHtml: Negative seven has a nonzero remainder on division by two, so the else branch prints Odd. The test asks for zero remainder, which works for positive and negative integers. It does not require the odd remainder to be positive one.

examples.title: Brace a nested eligibility rule
examples.explanationHtml: The outer true condition enters the registered branch. The inner comparison fails, so Practice first is selected. The explicit braces show that Register first belongs to the outer false path. A reader does not need to infer pairing from indentation.

practice.title: One passing message
practice.statementHtml: Read mark 0 to 100. After the prompt Input: , print Pass at 40 or above, otherwise Fail; end with newline.

practice.title: Signed parity
practice.statementHtml: Read number -100 to 100. After the prompt Input: , print Even or Odd and newline.

practice.title: Discount or normal bill
practice.statementHtml: Read bill 0 to 1000. After the prompt Input: , subtract 50 for a bill at least 500, otherwise add 10; print the final amount and newline.

practice.title: Registered certificate
practice.statementHtml: Read registered 0 or 1 and mark 0 to 100. After the prompt Input: , print Register first if unregistered; otherwise print Certificate for mark at least 40 or Practice first below 40. Finish with newline.

quiz.prompt: How many branches of one if-else execute?
quiz.explanation: The condition chooses one controlled statement.

quiz.prompt: Which condition belongs directly after else?
quiz.explanation: Use else if for another question.

quiz.prompt: Which if owns an unbraced dangling else?
options: The first if in the file
The one with the largest condition
quiz.explanation: C uses grammar rather than indentation.

quiz.prompt: Which parity test works for negative and positive integers?
quiz.explanation: Even values have zero remainder regardless of sign.

quiz.prompt: Where should a common final report line go?
quiz.explanation: Both paths can reach it after merging.

quiz.prompt: Does changing a condition variable inside the if branch run the else too?
quiz.explanation: The selection was already made for this decision.

quiz.prompt: What prevents accidental nested else pairing?
quiz.explanation: Braces encode the intended block structure.

quiz.prompt: Only one branch prints a letter. Which is selected?
A negative even integer is classified. Which label appears?
The chosen branch changes x. What value follows the decision?
quiz.explanation: Only the true branch runs; changing x does not revisit the selection.

Else handles a false paired condition.
keyPoints.bn: if-এর শর্ত মিথ্যা হলে তার else চলে।

keyPoints.en: Code after the decision is shared.
keyPoints.bn: decision-এর পরের কাজ দুই পথের জন্যই সাধারণ।

keyPoints.en: An else pairs with the nearest unmatched if.
keyPoints.bn: else সবচেয়ে কাছের unmatched if-এর সঙ্গে জোড়া লাগে।
nested if-এ braces দিলে কোন else কার, তা বোঝা যায়।

examQuestions.question: How many branches of one if-else execute?
examQuestions.answerHtml: Exactly one. The condition chooses one controlled statement.

examQuestions.question: Which condition belongs directly after else?
examQuestions.answerHtml: None. Use else if for another question.

examQuestions.question: Read registered 0 or 1 and mark 0 to 100. After Input: print Register first if unregistered; otherwise print Certificate for mark at least 40 or Practice first below 40. Finish with newline.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
#include <stdio.h>

int main(void)
{
    int registered, mark;
    printf("Input: ");
    if (scanf("%d %d", &registered, &mark) != 2 || registered < 0 || registered > 1 || mark < 0 || mark > 100) {
        return 1;
    }
    if (registered) {
        if (mark >= 40) {
            puts("Certificate");
        } else {
            puts("Practice first");
        }
    } else {
        puts("Register first");
    }
    return 0;
}
